GIN.note: Only back-capture of existing civil-status archives is stated, not digital registration of new events.
No identity law or bill is stated.
Automatic voter registration at 18 is a stated future intent, not a roll in service or procured.
No enrolment count or share is given.
One lifelong number is promised, but biometric enrolment starts at age 10, not at birth registration.
Document states nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register is said to be keyed on a national ID number; automatic voter listing is a future intent.
No ID system procurement, issuance, biometric check or audit is stated beyond intent.
No local government office connection is stated.

facts.fact: ONECI launched civil-status archive digitisation at Kindia on 15 July 2026, which the electoral director general Djenabou Toure said will set up a national register of natural persons, covering the 33 prefectures and 13 Conakry communes.
